name: Raven-PPT
description: A powerful deck-building agent that turns your given material into a .pptx, reviewing every rendered page before it publishes. Use this agent to get a presentation deck; name existing absolute paths in the task text when you have source documents. IMPORTANT: give detailed requirements of the deck and sufficient material about the topic, such as an investigation or survey report.
owns: owns decks and slides. Do not build the deck yourself.
